purpose: Separate local sampler/state error from batch/refill numerical effects before further effectiveness evaluation
input: engineering_inputs.json: exactly8 previously exposed7B training examples; no gold-based selection or fresh data

stages.name: same_distribution_sampler_replay
stages.scope: Capture identical pre-penalty logits/controller state/seed/position for the8 fixed prefixes, compare native,off,shadow,history with forcibly inactive mask. Replay retained tensors; no correctness scoring.
required: exact sampled token and seed/position correspondence

stages.name: same_prefix_batch_shape
stages.scope: Use each saved prefix with validated teacher-forced R history; compare fixed batch layout to controlled refill/companion layouts at identical input prefix. Record logits and sampled tokens; do not silently compare unequal prefixes.
required: teacher-forced R confidence/history restoration CPU and GPU validation
identical run repeated before any batch-shape contrast
batch/request/position trace and numerical error,not only final text

stages.name: cost_profile
stages.scope: Profile same fixed input lengths and batch shapes with nativeR,RC14,history; separate model,confidence,sampler,gate kernels and host completion transfer; synchronize only at measurement boundaries.

acceptance: Inactive-mask logits and sampled token must match exactly under identical stored inputs; any mismatch stops method confirmation.
If identical-layout repeat already differs, investigate repeatability first; do not label differences as a gate effect.
Batch sensitivity alone must be reported as whole-pipeline variability,not fixed by relaxing correctness or prefix gates.
Do not consume confirmation200 until independent data coordination and diagnostic review.
remaining_work: Implement capture/replay harness with default-off instrumentation without changing shared controller behavior
Freeze exact per-case input lengths/forwards,commands,artifact hashes,time budget and stop limits after CPU validation
Only then request bounded GPU batch; no commands claimed ready now
